# Stint

A minimalist timer for training, focus, and any timed session.

## What is Stint?

Stint is a free online timer with two modes:

- **Training mode**: For HIIT, Tabata, EMOM, AMRAP, circuit training, boxing rounds, and any interval workout

- **Focus mode**: For Pomodoro technique, deep work sessions, study sessions, and productivity

No signup, no ads, no app to install. Works in any modern browser on phone, tablet, or desktop.

## Key features

- Customizable work/rest intervals

- Multiple rounds and sessions

- Visual progress indicators

- Dark mode support

- Fullscreen mode for gym or workspace use

- Mobile and desktop responsive

## Use cases

- Tabata workouts (20s work / 10s rest, 8 rounds)

- HIIT training

- Pomodoro technique (25min focus / 5min break)

- Deep work sessions (60-90 minutes)

- Study timers

- Meditation and breathwork

- Boxing and martial arts rounds

- Circuit training

- EMOM (Every Minute On the Minute)

- AMRAP (As Many Rounds As Possible)

## Technology

Built as a Progressive Web App with React. No backend required — runs entirely in your browser.

## Privacy

Stint does not track users, does not require accounts, and does not show ads. Anonymous usage analytics via Plausible (cookie-free).
